source.description:
Sangpuy Promotional Portrait

Indigenous singer Sangpuy poses against a plain backdrop, dressed in a light blue denim jacket layered over a white shirt. His distinctive mullet haircut and oversized sunglasses frame a thoughtful downward gaze, conveying both modern style and cultural depth. 

This portrait accompanies promotional materials for the 2025 Autumn Arts Festival performance "Flowing Boundaries" at Taiwan’s National Theater and Concert Hall.
